description: The marks of a finished mock exam: the score, pass or fail, the result per topic, every mistake with the right answer and its note, and the theory sections to read. A question with option null was not answered and counts as wrong.

answers.description: One item per question of the exam.

option.description: A, B, C, D, or null when not answered.

lang.description: Language of the text: en (default) or ru. What is not translated yet comes in English.

name: grade_exam
title: Grade a mock exam
